cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Secure the Endorsement
cards.instruction: Get a visible endorsement that makes your decision or position harder to challenge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Sign here to say you support the extension.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like it, but I'd rather not put my name down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then your support has no address when objections arrive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if we print the key beside them.

mechanism: A sets the approved identification requirements for supporting an extension so endorsement cannot become anonymous when challenged.
confusable: General approval alone would not satisfy D52; the name must remain visibly attributable despite B proposed anonymity.
comparison: Signature identity is negotiated, unlike the rota scene widening the audience of an email.
seedUse: The existing D52-b conditional approval of initials with a printed key already joins superior control with identifiable endorsement.
